messages:
Maya: Hey friends — tiny personal flex: Alex and I celebrated our 5th wedding anniversary yesterday 🥂. Got a small leftover cake from the bakery. Thinking of bringing it to the SF office tomorrow around 3pm. Who's in for free cake? :cake:
Javier: Count me in. I will be there by 3. Will bring coffee. ☕️
Priya: OMG congrats!! 5 years, amazing ❤️. If you need help carrying it, I can grab it from you in the lobby.
Sam: Happy anniversary!! also please RSVP so we know how many forks to go buy :fork_and_knife: (kidding, but not really)
Lena: Huge congrats Maya!! :tada: Can you bring a photo? We should make a tiny card from the team.
Maya: Love that — I can bring a quick collage. Also, if anyone on the SF floor is remote tomorrow can we save 2 slices? @Priya?
Priya: Yep I can save two slices for the zoom crowd, leave them with reception and I'll grab later.
OpsBot: Reminder: Office snack table reserved for community events must clear all food by 5pm for cleaning crew.
Maya: Thanks OpsBot — will put signs and boxes out.
Javier: Someone should bring a Sharpie for messages on the card. Also: who wants candles? 
Sam: I'll bring candles (and matches) and a ridiculous anniversary meme.
Lena: Meme please. pls no dad jokes (no promises)
Priya: Quick poll: React with :cake: if you want a slice, :no_entry_sign: if not.
Maya: Also heads up — box is small (6" round). If we get >8 cake-lovers we do pizza fallback.
CateringBot: NOTE: Cake drop-off accepted at 2:45pm. If labeled "Maya / Anniversary" we will store in back fridge.
Maya: Amazing, will label. Thank you all. Really appreciate the love — feels like a virtual hug.
Sam: Congrats again! also apparently company policy allows one spontaneous team photo if it involves cake, so we'll get one and I promise not to post it in #all-hands. :grimacing:
Javier: Can someone take a photo with my new 2008 disposable camera? kidding.
Lena: I'll take a pic and post a tasteful collage in #random after lunch.
Priya: See y'all tomorrow. Also Maya — 5 years!! big huge congrats.
Maya: Thanks team. See you at 3. ❤️
